sources.title: Scaling the Horizon, Not the Parameters
sources.mechanism: Three-stage agent training: full-domain SFT → domain teachers → multi-teacher domain-routed on-policy distillation with Salient Vocabulary Alignment (SVA). SVA = truncated reverse KL on teacher top-k renormalized support. Domain-normalized loss averages within domain then across domains. KAG = (C,A,O,V) process-level supervision tuples (s,a,o,v).
sources.why_it_works: Authors claim process-level horizon scaling + avoiding cross-domain gradient conflict via hard teacher routing and domain-normalized aggregation. Plausible for heterogeneous agent skills; SVA addresses sampled-token OPD under-constraining nearby alternatives.
sources.limitation: Infrastructure-heavy; distillation assumes strong domain teachers; SVA does not constrain student mass outside teacher support; agent recipe not an architecture/quantization advance per se.
unexplored_variables: student-selected salient support instead of teacher-selected
asymmetric k per domain / per token entropy
apply salient-support truncation idea to attention softmax or to optimizer subspace
compose SVA with Muon-style spectral geometry on student updates
salient residual packing of discarded probability mass outside S^(k)

sources.title: Gated DeltaNet-2: Decoupling Erase and Write in Linear Attention
sources.mechanism: Linear recurrent state S_t with channel-wise decay α_t, erase gate b_t (key-side), write gate w_t (value-side). Delta-rule edit: erase current association before writing. Generalizes Gated DeltaNet and KDA.
sources.why_it_works: Erase and write are different geometric operations on the state; tying them to one scalar β_t forces suboptimal simultaneous forget/commit. Ablations claim erase gate accounts for most gain.
sources.limitation: Fixed-size state still compresses unbounded history; associative recall remains weaker than softmax attention; channel-wise gates add parameters; erase destroys information irreversibly.
unexplored_variables: echo/residual buffer that stores erased content at lower rank for later recovery
conflict-aware erase: modulate b_t by predicted key-collision energy
orthogonalize erase directions before write (Muon geometry on state edit)
signed sparse residual of erased associations at 1-2 bits

sources.title: Rotation and Hessian-aware PTQ (SpinQuant/QuaRot/KronQ)
sources.mechanism: Orthogonal/Hadamard rotations redistribute outliers; GPTQ/AWQ compensate weights; KronQ uses Kronecker-factored Hessian for sensitivity and mixed precision.
sources.why_it_works: Outliers dominate quantization error; rotations make coordinates more Gaussian; Hessian-aware bit allocation spends bits where loss curvature is high.
sources.limitation: Rotation search cost; residual quantization error after n-bit grid is structured (low-rank + sparse) but usually discarded or handled only via GPTQ compensation; mixed-precision metadata overhead.
unexplored_variables: explicit spectral residual packing of W-Q(W) via top-r SVD at matched total bit budget
sign-consistent residual codebook on largest-magnitude reconstruction errors
combine learned rotation with spectral residual instead of only finer grid bits
salient-column residual: store residuals only for top-Hessian columns

sources.title: Muon / NorMuon / AMUSE optimizers
sources.mechanism: Orthogonalize momentum matrix via Newton-Schulz; treat 2D params as matrices; often AdamW for vectors/embeddings. AMUSE blends Schedule-Free averaging with Muon.
sources.why_it_works: Spectral-norm steepest descent / Stiefel-like geometry accelerates progress along flat bulk directions; weight decay + update RMS scaling needed for large models.
sources.limitation: Full-matrix orthogonalization cost; amplifies valley-wall noise (AMUSE); not always best for all parameter types; Newton-Schulz iterations add wall-clock.
unexplored_variables: salient-subspace Muon: orthogonalize only top-k singular subspace of momentum, Adam-like on complement
domain-normalized multi-task Muon updates (Agents-A1 style aggregation)
erase-write gated preconditioning for linear-attention state params
